label: an + sonido vocálico
sentence: It took us ___ hour and a half to drive from the airport to the hotel.
explanation: AN va delante de SONIDO vocálico, no de letra vocal. La h de 'hour' es muda: suena 'our'.

label: the + only
sentence: She is ___ only person in this office who knows how the old machine works.
explanation: 'the only' lleva artículo definido: hay una sola persona así, es única.

label: the + superlativo
sentence: That was by far ___ most difficult exam I have ever had to take.
explanation: El superlativo siempre lleva THE delante.

label: a + sonido consonántico
sentence: He has ___ university degree in history from a college in the north.
explanation: 'University' empieza con sonido /ju:/, que es consonántico. Por eso A y no AN.

label: deducción negativa
sentence: He ___ not have taken the keys, because he was with me the whole afternoon.
explanation: Deducción negativa sobre el pasado: couldn't / can't + have + participio.

label: inversión con never
sentence: Never ___ I seen such a beautiful sunset as the one we saw last night.
explanation: Con NEVER al principio hay inversión: auxiliar + sujeto. 'Never have I seen'.

label: inversión con rarely
sentence: Rarely ___ we see such a talented young player in this league.
explanation: RARELY al principio también fuerza inversión, y con presente simple el auxiliar es DO.

label: did not + infinitivo
sentence: She ___ not realise how late it was until the phone suddenly rang.
explanation: Negación en pasado simple: DID + not + infinitivo sin to.

label: to have been + participio
sentence: The bridge is said to ___ been built more than two hundred years ago.
explanation: Infinitivo perfecto en pasiva: to HAVE been + participio.

label: tercer condicional
sentence: If I ___ known you were coming, I would have made something to eat.
explanation: Tercer condicional: la parte del IF va en past perfect.

label: not as ... as
sentence: She is not ___ tall as her older sister, but she plays much better.
explanation: 'not as + adjetivo + as' para comparar igualdad.

label: comparativo + than
sentence: The exam turned out to be much harder ___ I had expected it to be.
explanation: Después de un comparativo (harder) va THAN.

label: the more ... the better
sentence: The ___ you practise, the better you will get at playing the piano.
explanation: 'The + comparativo..., the + comparativo...' expresa proporción.

label: as well as
sentence: She speaks French as ___ as Italian and a little bit of German.
explanation: 'as well as' = además de.

label: at least
sentence: It will take at ___ three hours to get there by train from here.
explanation: 'at least' = como mínimo.

label: by means of
sentence: The message was finally delivered by ___ of a private courier.
explanation: 'by means of' = por medio de.

label: in case
sentence: Take an umbrella with you in ___ it rains later this afternoon.
explanation: 'in case' + presente expresa precaución, nunca con WILL.

label: in order to
sentence: She stayed up all night in ___ to finish the essay before the deadline.
explanation: 'in order to' + infinitivo expresa propósito.

label: in spite of
sentence: In ___ of the terrible weather, the trip went ahead exactly as planned.
explanation: 'in spite of' + sustantivo o gerundio. Equivale a DESPITE.

label: instead of
sentence: We decided to walk ___ of taking the bus, since it was such a lovely evening.
explanation: 'instead of' + sustantivo o gerundio.

label: no matter what
sentence: No ___ what you say to him, he is never going to change his mind.
explanation: 'no matter what/how/when' = da igual qué.

label: on behalf of
sentence: I am speaking here today on ___ of the whole research team.
explanation: 'on behalf of' = en nombre de.

label: although / though
sentence: He plays like a professional ___ he is only fourteen years old.
explanation: ALTHOUGH o THOUGH introducen una oración con sujeto y verbo. DESPITE no podría.

label: due to / owing to
sentence: The concert was cancelled ___ to the storm that hit the coast on Friday.
explanation: 'due to' y 'owing to' introducen la causa, seguidas de sustantivo.

label: not only ... but also
sentence: Not ___ did she apologise, but she also paid for all the damage.
explanation: 'Not only' al principio fuerza inversión: not only DID she apologise.

label: so that
sentence: She left extremely early ___ that she would not get stuck in the traffic.
explanation: 'so that' introduce propósito.

label: unless
sentence: We will go ahead with the picnic ___ it rains before midday.
explanation: UNLESS = if not. Ya es negativo, así que el verbo va en afirmativo.

label: whereas / while
sentence: My sister loves the countryside, ___ I have always preferred big cities.
explanation: WHEREAS y WHILE marcan contraste entre dos hechos paralelos.

label: apart from
sentence: Apart ___ the ending, I thought the film was absolutely excellent.
explanation: 'apart FROM' = excepto. También existe 'aside from', pero apart pide FROM.

label: by + agente
sentence: The novel was written ___ a woman who had never left her village.
explanation: En pasiva, el agente va introducido por BY.

label: good at + gerundio
sentence: She was always very good ___ persuading people to change their minds.
explanation: 'good AT something'. El calco de 'buena EN' lleva a poner IN.

label: no point in + gerundio
sentence: There is no point ___ complaining about it now that everything is over.
explanation: 'there is no point IN doing something'. Después de la preposición va gerundio.

label: responsible for
sentence: She is responsible ___ everything that happens in this department.
explanation: 'responsible FOR' es fijo.

label: since + momento
sentence: I have known her ___ we were at primary school together.
explanation: SINCE marca el punto de partida en el tiempo y va con present perfect.

label: it como objeto anticipado
sentence: I find ___ very difficult to concentrate when the radio is on.
explanation: 'find IT difficult TO do something': IT anticipa el infinitivo que viene después.

label: there is
sentence: As far as I know, ___ is no reason at all to worry about the results.
explanation: 'there is/are' para expresar existencia. IT sería el sujeto de otra estructura.

label: what = lo que
sentence: That is exactly ___ I was trying to explain to you yesterday afternoon.
explanation: WHAT equivale a 'lo que'. THAT necesitaría un sustantivo antes.

label: which comentando la oración
sentence: He arrived two hours late, ___ annoyed absolutely everybody at the meeting.
explanation: WHICH después de coma comenta toda la oración anterior, no un sustantivo suelto.

label: whose = cuyo
sentence: The woman ___ car was stolen last night has already reported it to the police.
explanation: WHOSE indica posesión: el auto DE la mujer.

label: a few of
sentence: Only a ___ of the guests stayed until the very end of the party.
explanation: 'a few of' con contables. 'a little of' sería para incontables.

label: hardly any
sentence: We have hardly ___ time left, so we had better hurry up.
explanation: 'hardly any' = casi nada. HARDLY ya es negativo, por eso ANY y no SOME.

label: very little + incontable
sentence: She has very ___ interest in politics these days, which surprises me.
explanation: 'very little' con incontables: interest no se cuenta.

label: neither of + dos
sentence: To be honest, ___ of the two options seemed particularly attractive to us.
explanation: NEITHER se usa cuando son exactamente DOS. Para más de dos iría NONE.

label: none of
sentence: Unfortunately, ___ of the students had done the reading beforehand.
explanation: NONE OF + grupo. NO iría directamente con el sustantivo, sin OF.

label: so many + contable
sentence: There were so ___ people at the concert that we could hardly move.
explanation: MANY con contables en plural. MUCH sería para incontables.
